title: cyperus laetus var. cephalanthus
intro: Cyperus laetus var. cephalanthus, commonly known as the 'Golden Sedge', is a type of flowering plant belonging to the sedge family. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and aid in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus laetus var. cephalanthus include its diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help in relieving respiratory issues and promoting the removal of excess fluids from the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
